title: Songwriter Open Mic @ bmc brewing
event_description: Acoustic singer-songwriter open mic welcoming both original songs and covers. Performers get 2-4 songs depending on attendance with up to two musicians on stage at once. Pass the hat event with donations split among artists.
event_venue_information:
About bmc brewing

bmc brewing is a family-owned nanobrewery located in the heart of The Plant in Pittsboro. The brewery features 18 taps of beer brewed on-site using locally sourced ingredients and ultra-purified reverse osmosis water. The venue includes a taproom brewery and the Smelt Art Gallery.

Music and Events

The brewery hosts regular live music events open mic nights pint nights and special deals. They feature songwriter open mics on select Sundays from 2-5 PM and original-song-only open mics on Thursdays at 7 PM. The venue partners with neighboring businesses at The Plant including Starrlight Mead and Fair Game Beverage for collaborations and special events.

The Venue Experience

bmc brewing offers both indoor seating in their quirky converted building and outdoor patio space. The taproom has a relaxed community-focused atmosphere perfect for discovering new craft beer styles. The brewery is all about sustainability using solar power and processing spent grains into flour for their signature cookies sold under the Bite My Cookies brand.

About The City Tap

The City Tap is a beloved downtown Pittsboro establishment known for its North Carolina craft beers and delicious sandwiches soups and salads made with quality local ingredients. The venue has been a significant part of the downtown Pittsboro scene particularly for live music and open mic events.

Music Programming

The City Tap hosts the Tap In listening experience on the second and fourth Wednesday of every month from 7-9 PM. This intimate acoustic-only space features original songs from local Chatham musicians. The venue regularly features live music several nights a week on their patio showcasing various local and regional artists. Past events have included performances by bands like Trash Van Fever Mike Edwards and His Only Friends and Bad Penny.

Atmosphere and Community

Known as Pittsboro's version of the town pump The City Tap offers a warm welcoming atmosphere with both indoor and outdoor seating. The venue has built a reputation for great live music interesting beer selections and quality food service. It serves as a community gathering place where locals and visitors can enjoy craft beverages good food and acoustic music in downtown Pittsboro.

title: Open Mic @ Fair Game Beverage Company
event_description: Open mic night for all musicians at Fair Game Beverage Company located in The Plant. Performers can showcase their talents in the Wheelhouse space. A welcoming environment for local artists to share their music with the community.
venue_name: Fair Game Beverage Company / The Plant

About Fair Game Beverage Company

Fair Game Beverage Company is North Carolina's 13th distillery located at The Plant in the Chatham Beverage District. The distillery specializes in small-batch spirits including Balancing Act Gin Amber Rum Flying Pepper Vodka and Province of Carolina rum. They craft sustainably-produced bespoke spirits from locally grown produce turned into delicious seasonal cocktails.

The Venue and Events

Fair Game operates both a Tasting Room and the Events Bar in the Wheelhouse space which hosts monthly events including Open Mic nights on the first and third Wednesday of each month Poetry Readings Trivia nights with host Erin and Irish Music sessions. The venue welcomes private parties corporate events and special gatherings in their versatile spaces.

The Plant Experience

As part of The Plant's 17-acre eco-industrial park Fair Game shares the campus with bmc brewing Starrlight Mead & Cider Koshu Sake and numerous other local businesses. Visitors can enjoy craft beverages from multiple vendors explore art galleries axe throwing walking trails and outdoor gathering spaces. The Wheelhouse provides an intimate setting perfect for acoustic performances and community events. Tours of the distillery are available on Saturdays at noon or by appointment.
